integrity: Exact statement and classical inputs are delineated; a self-contained finite quotient checker is supplied as corroboration, not as a replacement for the manifold proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the regular seven-gon noncrossing-diagonal complex and its full fourteen-element dihedral quotient are classified. The proof relies on established secondary-polytope, orbit fundamental group, and Poincare theorems. Independent mathematical validation and comprehensive historical priority verification are not claimed.
title: The full dihedral quotient of the heptagon associahedral sphere is a three-sphere
